exposure: PKU genotype (classic PKU vs. mild hyperphenylalaninemia)
Maternal body weight gain during pregnancy
outcome: Phenylalanine tolerance during preconception and pregnancy
cohort: The study followed 10 pregnancies in 7 women affected by Phenylketonuria (PKU) with 7 different genotypes.
finding: Phenylalanine tolerance systematically increased during pregnancy in all women, but the magnitude of increase differed significantly between women with classic PKU and those with mild hyperphenylalaninemia, and also varied in the same women across different pregnancies depending on body weight gain.
